About

About the Model Congress

Constitutional basis

Art. VI, Sec. 1. Legislative power is vested in the Congress of the Philippines, which consists of a Senate and a House of Representatives.

Art. VI, Sec. 5. The House is composed of district representatives and party-list representatives.

Art. VI, Sec. 26(2) and Sec. 27. A bill passes three readings on separate days, and every bill passed by Congress is presented to the President.

1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines; Rules of the House of Representatives

    The ISPSC Model Congress is an academic legislative simulation of the BPA program of Ilocos Sur Polytechnic State College. Titles, districts, and party-list affiliations are role assignments for the simulation. This page is not an official website of the House of Representatives of the Philippines.
